unchanged_A28_gates.empty_region_policy: report null recall if no GT positives; no claim of protection from an empty set
unchanged_A28_gates.ranking_after_all_gates: descending 512 AH macro Dice, then fewer distance filters, shorter length, lower margin, lower penalty, candidate ID
unchanged_A28_gates.no_eligible_candidate: REJECT_R2_FAMILY_FOR_PL; preserve all runs, do not relax gates; next revision requires its own preregistration

ranking: After ALL old and new gates: descending 512 train AH macro Dice, smaller maximum gap, candidate ID; zero eligible => reject, no relaxed gates

processing.image: Unchanged Gaussian3 green before LUT; no labels or bright-region evaluation mask enters the candidate
processing.gradient: At each line point let C=center, L/R=perpendicular samples at +/-d, LL/RR=at +/-2d. Four-times corrected contrasts l=4*(L-C)+RR-LL, r=4*(R-C)-RR+LL. Sum each along line. Samples independently replicate at image edges. Unclipped affine ramps cancel exactly in interior only.
processing.integer_bounds: Single corrected contrast +/-1275, length9 sum +/-11475; ratio products and sums int32. Count uint8. No division, uint8 wrap or post-LUT saturation.
processing.retention: Any length/direction/distance with min(sum l,sum r)>=4*length and max<=ratio*min retains original C2 pixel within original FOV. ratio2 or4. gradient mode uses this only; union additionally OR fixed r3 uncorrected 5/9 ratio8 margin1 evidence. Four noadd ablations.
processing.addition: Both lengths5 and9 in same direction need corrected min>=8*length, ratio balance, center itself both corrected contrasts positive, >=2/3 points both positive. OR distances independently for each scale, AND scales per direction. Fixed mean margin2, no GT.
processing.connection: One pass; gap up to1 or3 absent pixels, two original retained C2 endpoints. Endpoints and gap all directional weak-supported and within FOV. Context1,3,5 requires that many consecutive supported original-seed pixels from each endpoint outward. New pixels never become endpoints/context. No post closing or dilation.
processing.output: Retained C2 seed OR audited supported gap pixels. 2 ratios x2 retention modes x(1 noadd +3 contexts x2 gaps)=28. No production/FPGA changes.
processing.scope_limit: Local affine correction need not fit sharp or nonlinear bright rims; four straight directions and short gaps cannot restore all missing branches. Longer seed context can reject curved vessels. These are hypotheses under fixed quality gates, not assured improvements.

evaluation.regions: UNCHANGED Q1/Q3 diagnostic regions and FOV, full_image, bright_core, bright_band, thin_label_proxy, fov_edge
evaluation.cldice: Zhang skimage skeletons inside original FOV; topology precision=pred skeleton in GT/pred skeleton; recall=GT skeleton in pred/GT skeleton; harmonic mean. Empty GT=null. No tolerance dilation. Not complete topology proof.
evaluation.adjacent_edge_coverage: GT skeleton 8-neighbor undirected edges, covered iff both endpoints inside prediction. Local continuity proxy only, not global connectivity.
evaluation.bridges: Gate all pixels added relative to retained C2 seed, including restoration of a removed C2 pixel; separately record full C2-relative additions/removals. Same added precision>=0.8 gate. No post-connection morphology. Links retain original both-end/interior annotation audit.
evaluation.cross_validation: Finite train AH screen only; all per-image results retained. No heldout/VK new-candidate decode/score. No nested or fresh external validation claim.

rationale: All 93 r1/r2/r3 candidates rejected. R3 loses genuine bright-band vessels with asymmetric local background, and erroneous C2 endpoints seed most added false positives. Test finite image-only local affine-ramp compensation, plus consecutive outward endpoint context. Preserve all numeric gates. Do not expand r3 grid or use labels at runtime.
reference_scope: Zhang et al 2010 motivates separation of line and edge responses. This custom finite outer-sample affine compensation is NOT reproduction of MF-FDOG and borrows no published accuracy. Original clDice source used only for evaluation.
